FEAT-2-S126.title: Define Specialty Identification Request/Response Schema
FEAT-2-S126.description: Create and validate Pydantic models for specialty identification inputs and outputs, including user query, expanded query variants, NUCC code list, ranking scores, and confidence metadata.

FEAT-2-S127.title: Implement Dual-Pipeline Specialty Mapping Logic
FEAT-2-S127.description: Implement core specialty identification logic combining regex-based matching and vector similarity in parallel, including query expansion and NUCC code aggregation with deduplication.

FEAT-2-S128.title: Expose Specialty Identification via Tool Router
FEAT-2-S128.description: Register specialty identification as an allowlisted tool in the tool_router with validated inputs and structured outputs, ensuring compatibility with the LLM tool-use flow.

FEAT-2-S129.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Identification
FEAT-2-S129.description: Develop tests covering regex matching, vector matching, query expansion, NUCC deduplication, and end-to-end tool invocation through the tool router.

FEAT-2-S130.title: NUCC Taxonomy Data Integration for Specialty Mapping
FEAT-2-S130.description: Integrate NUCC specialty taxonomy dataset into specialty_service, ensuring mappings are consistent with provider_search_service fallback logic and support classification aggregation.
